title: WPMS/2168/2014 of Arun Bagla Vs Ashok Prappan Sharma AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 2168 of 2014 (M/S)
Arun Bagla Ö...Petitoners.
Versus
Ashok Prappan Sharma & others ....Respondents.
Present:
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the respondents.
Honíble Alok Singh, J. (Oral)
 During the pendency of Suit No. 40 of 1991 pending
in the Court of Civil Judge, Dehradun, the sole defendant Smt.
Chameli Devi died; an application for substitution of the LR of
Chameli Devi was moved saying Kishan Lal Bagla, Govind Lal
Bagla and Jagmohan Prasad Bagla, the natural sons of Chameli
Devi, be substituted as LRs of sole defendant of Chameli Devi;
before substitution application substituting the LRs of the
defendant could be allowed, Jagmohan Prasad, one of the
proposed LRs of Chameli Devi also died; petitioner was added
as LR of Jagmohan Prasad in the substitution application;
before the substitution application substituting the LRs of
Chameli Devi could be allowed, sole plaintiff also died;
therefore, an application was moved by the LRs of the
plaintiffs/respondents herein for substituting them as legal heirs
of plaintiff; during the pendency of the substitution application of
the LRs of the plaintiff, Kisan Lal Bagla one of the LRs of the
sole defendant also expired. Application seeking substitution of

the LRs of the plaintiff was dismissed by the Trial Court, vide
order dated 01.08.2013, on the ground that delay in moving
substitution application for substituting LR of plaintiff has not
been explained nor applications seeking condonation of delay
or setting aside the abetment was moved and ultimately suit
was dismissed as abetted; feeling aggrieved LRs of the plaintiff
i.e. respondents herein, preferred an appeal before the District
Judge; in an appeal Kishan Lal Bagla, Govind Lal Bagla and
present petitioner were impleaded as party respondents; an
objection was raised by the present petitioner as well as Govind
Lal Bagla that appeal was filed against the dead person i.e.
Kishal Lal; thereafter appellant/respondents, herein, moved an
application to implead legal heirs of Kishan Lal as party
respondents, which was allowed by the Appellate Court, vide
order dated 17.01.2014; thereafter present petitioner moved an
application for recalling of the order dated 17.01.2014 saying
that since appeal was filed against the dead person and Kishan
Lal, one of the LRs of the original defendant, had died during
the pendency of the suit, therefore, his legal heirs cannot be
permitted to be added as party respondent in place of dead
person Kishan Lal. Recall application so moved by the present
petitioner was dismissed by the Appellate Court, vide order
dated 08.08.2014. Feeling aggrieved, petitioner has filed present
petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India.

I have heard Mr. Nikhil Singhal, learned counsel for
petitioner and Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for the
respondents, and have carefully perused the record.
Undisputedly, before the substitution application of the
LR of the defendant could be allowed, plaintiff himself had
died and application moved by the LRs of the plaintiff
substituting them as LRs of the plaintiff was dismissed on the
ground that it was not moved within time nor an application
was moved for setting aside the abetment and condonation of
delay. Feeling aggrieved, appeal was filed by the LRs of the
plaintiff.
In my considered opinion, since application for
substitution of the LR of the defendant was pending when
plaintiff had died, therefore, LRs of the plaintiff could have
moved only amendment application for bringing on record
LRs of the proposed LR of defendant no. 1, which was rightly
done by the LRs of the plaintiff/appellant, and was rightly
allowed by the learned Appellate Court.
Consequently, petition fails and is hereby dismissed.
CLMA No. 10549 of 2014 also stands disposed of
accordingly.
